## Description {#details}

<p>Common base class for all memory intrinsics.</p>


<p>Simply provides common methods. Written as CRTP to avoid a common base class amongst the three atomicity hierarchies.</p>


<p>Definition at line 970 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/intrinsicinst-h">IntrinsicInst.h</a>.</p>
